title: FlowRecordElementOccurrence - Data API
description: Represents the execution metrics for a single element within a flow version. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency associated with the flow. Possible values are: USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

Entries.description: The number of times the element was initiated in all flow interviews after the flow version was executed.

Errors.description: The number of errors for the element in all flow interviews after the flow version was executed.

Exits.description: The number of times the element was executed to completion in all flow interviews after the flow version was executed.

FlowRecordElementId.description: The ID of the flow element. This field is a relationship field.

FlowRecordId.description: The ID of the flow. This field is a relationship field.

FlowRecordVersionId.description: The ID of the flow version. This field is a relationship field.

FlowRecordVersionOccurrenceId.description: The ID of the flow occurrence. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The API name of the flow element.

Stopped.description: The number of times execution of the element was stopped in all flow interviews after the flow version was executed.

TotalDuration.description: The total time in milliseconds spent executing the element in all flow interviews.

associated_objects:

- **FlowRecordElementOccurrenceShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
